front: Deliberately overload your innovation so it explodes, damaging nearby creatures but not the innovation itself.
back:
2d6 fire damage, basic Reflex save, to all creatures in a 5-foot emanation around you (if worn or held innovation) or around the innovation (if a minion).
At 3rd level and every level after, +1d6 damage.
Breakthrough innovation: choose a 5-foot or 10-foot emanation.
Revolutionary innovation: choose a 5-, 10-, or 15-foot emanation.
